mapper.sql: CASE WHEN p.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN sd.status = 'APPROVED' THEN 'SETTLED' WHEN sd.status = 'DRAFT' THEN 'SETTLING' ELSE 'TO_SETTLE' END

FROM prd_order p JOIN sup_supplier f ON f.id = p.factory_id JOIN sty_style s ON s.id = p.style_id LEFT JOIN inv_doc sd ON sd.source_type = 'PRODUCTION_ORDER' AND sd.source_id = p.id AND sd.doc_type = 'CONSUME_OUT' AND sd.status <> 'VOIDED' WHERE p.issue_status IS NOT NULL AND p.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING', 'DONE', 'CLOSED') AND (p.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') OR sd.id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_doc d WHERE d.source_type = 'PRODUCTION_ORDER' AND d.source_id = p.id AND d.doc_type = 'ISSUE_OUT' AND d.status = 'APPROVED') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prd_order_item i WHERE i.prd_order_id = p.id AND i.returned_qty > i.defect_qty)) AND (p.create_by = #{scope.userId} OR p.merch_id = #{scope.userId}) AND p.product_line = ANY(#{scope.lines.values, typeHandler=com.lingmao.scm.common.mybatis.StringArrayTypeHandler}) AND p.factory_id = #{q.factoryId} AND p.kind = #{q.kind}
AND (upper(p.no) LIKE #{keywordCode} OR upper(s.code) LIKE #{keywordCode})
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.no, p.kind, p.factory_id, f.short_name AS factory_short_name, p.style_id, s.code AS style_code, s.name AS style_name, p.total_qty, p.status, p.due_date, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.returned_qty - i.defect_qty), 0) FROM prd_order_item i WHERE i.prd_order_id = p.id) AS good_qty, AS ledger_status, sd.id AS settle_doc_id, sd.no AS settle_doc_no, sd.status AS settle_doc_status
AND = #{q.status} ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT AS status, COUNT(*) AS count
GROUP BY 1
